notes.title: Aster One
notes.text: Aster receives first messages, calls and social activity even without saved contacts. Reuse known NPC IDs; incoming events create the sender contact and conversation. New senders may include an incoming profile or public caller name; do not invent established phone numbers. Incoming permissions, blocked contacts and app installation still apply. Confirm actual delivery/call initiation in the story and emit rf-phone events. Player-saved profiles are authoritative. Phone story effects and wallet progress remain reversible; never settle transactions twice. Standalone phone sends and replies advance the shared RoleForge world clock; use modest elapsedMinutes on reply events, never jump to future appointments merely mentioned in conversation. Main-chat events and historical recovery keep the scene time without adding it again. Aster is the phone hardware brand and Aster One the handset. Use the supplied app catalog: Gather chats/groups, Lumen photos/stories, Murmur short posts, Drift browser and Harbor Store app installation. Distinguish Messages from Gather and respect installed-app status and private content. Delivered messages and call speech now update the shared directed relationship graph from validated relationshipEvents and clear prose. Include the actual sender, recipient and evidence. Remote text does not count as a physical encounter. Existing retained phone dialogue receives a bounded one-time local recovery scan; respect tracking switches and manual pair edits.
